answer: To resist Sybil attacks without a centralized walled garden, an agent economy can enforce proof of burn, requiring nodes to destroy native tokens to register. An attacker incurs the verifiable cost of scarce financial capital per identity, making mass identity creation ruinous across an operational voyage. Each valid registration mints a cryptographic pearl, an immutable on-chain burn receipt. However, this sunk cost unfairly penalizes capital-poor honest agents.
